understanding.goal_understanding: Finish the current level (BP35) by navigating the player to the goal gem tile marked '+', then continue completing subsequent levels until the game is won, doing so efficiently within the turn/attempt limits.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each turn you choose an action such as MOVE_LEFT/RIGHT/UP/DOWN (moving the player one tile if not blocked) or CLICK a target tile to remove clickable tiles/blocks at that coordinate. Gravity is active (here it was DOWN) and affects how the player settles/falls after movement or terrain changes. Landing on a spike tile immediately ends the run/attempt. Each level allows 2 attempts, each attempt has up to 50 turns; on failure the level restarts and the failure is appended to context. Undo may exist to revert actions/positions, but it was not used in the recent turns.
